name: rarity.yagens_attributes.legendary
description: Base Endo cost for upgrading level 0 to 1. An upgrade from level L to L+1 costs base_endo * 2^L. Recycling grants floor(2^(base_endo-1) + base_endo*(2^level-1)/2) Endo per card. Color is an RGB hex value; order controls ascending Creative-tab sorting.
